title: Malaysian Chicken Skewers with Herby Marinade
description: Tender and juicy chicken skewers marinated in a herby mixture, perfect for a quick and flavorful dinner. The combination of Malaysian spices and fresh herbs creates a unique and aromatic flavor profile.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine herby marinade ingredients and blend until smooth.
In a large bowl, whisk together marinade, chicken, and a pinch of salt. Let marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Thread chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until chicken is cooked through.
Meanwhile, grill pineapple wedges for 2-3 minutes per side, or until caramelized.
To serve, place a skewer on each plate, top with grilled pineapple, and sprinkle with toasted coconut flakes and a drizzle of Malaysian chili sauce.
